summary: A feature article profiling emerging women artists across painting, street art, sculpture, photography, music, digital and traditional media worldwide. It highlights works and dates from late 2023, including exhibitions, installations, albums and performances. The piece argues that these women are redefining the art world and bringing diversity, multicultural perspectives and innovation.
one_line: A feature profiling emerging women artists worldwide across visual art, music, digital media and traditional crafts, with their major 2023 works.
key_facts: Vanessa Ford had a major solo exhibition at the Seneca Gallery in New York City on October 4, 2023; her large-scale canvases depict underrepresented groups and the intersectionality of race, gender, and class.
Elise Lefevre has made graffiti murals in Paris since September 2023, depicting heroic women from literature and history.
Kenyan artist Amani Okello unveiled an installation on November 15, 2023, at Hakuna Matata Sculpture Park in Nairobi, embodying 'Ubuntu' using reclaimed metal and wood.
Mariana Costa of Sao Paulo won the Verde Art Prize for life-size human sculptures made from recycled materials.
Mariana Costa's exhibition "Fragments of Existence" debuted September 20, 2023, at the Contemporary Art Museum of Sao Paulo.
Pakistani photographer Ayesha Rizwan's black and white collection "Shards of the Everyday" on life in Lahore has been displayed at the Lahore Modern Art Museum since October 2023.
Australian indigenous photographer Matilda Brown's landscape series on the Aboriginal concept of "Dreamtime" has been at the National Gallery of Victoria since December 2023.
Mexican-American composer Sofia Martinez's symphony "La Frontera" was performed by the Los Angeles Philharmonic on September 9, 2023, mixing Mexican folk music with classical composition.
Aria Li, a Chinese-American pianist and composer, released the jazz album "Whispers of the Silk Road" in November 2023, and it quickly climbed jazz charts.
Russian digital artist Anna Petrovna's VR experience "Otherworld" premiered December 1, 2023, in Moscow.
Nigerian multimedia artist Zara Okoro's AR project "Visible Histories" lets viewers see Lagos's layered past through smartphones.
Indian-American artist Anjali Desai unveiled her linocut series "Botanica" at the Boston Art Fair on October 22, 2023.
Japanese artist Saki Tanaka merges calligraphy with modern abstraction and has drawn attention in Tokyo.
